data.body: Closing: the final acceptance criterion is satisfied by ticket 6543-24a7-d2fb-4ff9's merged re-scope (Gerrit change 2114, merge commit af3ea35617fcaaa7c4ff58d5d24fd989578bafd1, LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 on post-timeout-fix main). Per the operator ruling, the 0707 dense-banking eval now measures SYSTEM-level boundedness: durable bank writes count regardless of actor (genuine model records AND the policy's silent bounded-fallback snapshots; seeded cache seeds excluded), with the bounded-gap assertion unchanged. Stub replay against the real CompletionEvidencePolicy proves the live run-32575679530 shape ([2,5,6,7,8] first banks under system scope) passes and a genuinely-unbounded transcript is rejected. Live bedrock is not locally runnable — live confirmation lands on the next scheduled/dispatched external-integration run.
